outcome: Opinions on vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC)
Factors influencing VBAC acceptance and preference
cohort: 283 pregnant women with a history of previous C-section, attending a research and training hospital in Istanbul
finding: Despite positive perceptions of VBAC, many women in the study did not choose this method, influenced by their previous birth experiences and care received.
mod_finding: Dissatisfaction with previous C-section significantly increased the likelihood of finding VBAC acceptable and expressing a willingness to have a VBAC.
